description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for the DurableQueue class, which implements a persistent FIFO queue using Orleans' journaling infrastructure. The tests verify core operations such as enqueue, dequeue, peek, persistence, handling of complex objects, clearing the queue, and recovery after restart, as well as handling of edge cases, enumeration, large data sets, and concurrent operations.

classes.name: DurableQueueTests
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for the DurableQueue implementation, covering typical operations, edge cases, recovery, and performance.

methods.name: DurableQueue_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests fundamental queue operations like enqueue, dequeue, peek, and count, ensuring FIFO order and persistence.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Ensures that queue state persists across recreations and is correctly recovered.

methods.name: DurableQueue_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Verifies serialization and deserialization of custom complex objects within the queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests clearing the queue and verifies journaled removal of all items.

methods.name: DurableQueue_EmptyQueueOperations_Test
methods.description: Checks that operations on an empty queue throw appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Validates that the queue can be enumerated in FIFO order.

methods.name: DurableQueue_LargeNumberOfOperations_Test
methods.description: Performs a stress test with many enqueue and dequeue operations to verify robustness and correct recovery.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Concurrent_EnqueueDequeue_Test
methods.description: Simulates concurrent batch enqueue/dequeue operations and verifies correct ordering and recovery in a concurrent scenario.
